description: This file defines a bot class for querying item location and stock information within an ERP system, using the Frappe framework. It implements user query handling to find items and their stock status, generating formatted responses.

classes.name: FindItemBot
classes.description: A bot class inheriting from BotParser, to handle item location and stock queries within the ERP system.

methods.name: get_reply(self)
methods.description: Processes user input to find items by keywords, checks permissions, queries the database for matching items and their stock levels, and returns a formatted reply.
